newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks seen drifting lower, focus on North Star.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen drifting lower, focus on North Star.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to drift lower on Wednesday following an easier overnight close on Wall Street and a downturn in the U.S. bond market on reignited fears that U.S. interest rates may rise, brokers said.

"A downward adjustment is expected today but the index should move within a 100-point range," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas. "The market's focus is on Beijing North Star, which starts trading today."
The Hang Seng Index fell 81.34 points to 13,906.46 on Tuesday, while the Hang Seng London Reference Index put on 33.01 points to 13,939.47.
